import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd(); h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert h(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes())=='09d30b7389779cc5072304edc3034a78be2d85ac9e0abe7e7e7f4ff603e620a9'
ids=set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); found={}
root=lane.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
for p in sorted(root.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 b=p.read_bytes(); ch=h(b)
 for i,line in enumerate(b.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  if not any(str(k).encode() in line for k in ids):continue
  o=json.loads(line); k=o.get('mathdb_id',o.get('id'))
  if k not in ids:continue
  print('RECORD',k,json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False))
  found[str(k)]={'chunk_path':str(p),'chunk_sha256':ch,'line_1based':i,'raw_base64_including_original_newline':base64.b64encode(line).decode(),'raw_sha256':h(line),'parsed':o}
assert len(found)==20,(len(found),list(found))
s=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'raw-provenance.json'],input=json.dumps({'schema':'r382-v1 raw bytes base64 preserve original newline; full parsed records','records':found},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert s.returncode==0
